title: Story Architect Agent Request
description: REQUEST contract consumed by AGT-04 story-architect-agent 1.x. Envelope per GDE-003 §4.1. The model receives `data` only; the envelope is assembled and validated by the agent runtime. `data.verificationPackage` is a subset of the Verification Package (`fact-verification-agent-output/v1#/$defs/verificationPackage`) — only the fields story architecture needs; `verificationConfidence`, `corroboration`, `quoteProvenance`, `causalAnalysis`, and `calculationCheck` are the Verification Package's own evidentiary reasoning and are not required here (GDE-002 §5.1 minimum-context principle). `data.topicOpportunity` is a subset of the Topic Candidates, mirroring `research-agent-input/v1#/$defs/topicOpportunityRef` exactly. Schema version 1.0.0. All enumerations are CLOSED unless a property description states otherwise; adding a member is a MAJOR change (STD-000 §5.5). All string lengths are counted in Unicode code points.

references.description: Outbound pointers to governing artifacts (GDE-003 §10). Unordered. 0-40 items. Populated by the runtime, never by the model.

isoTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with millisecond precision (STD-000 §5.7).

bcp47Tag.description: BCP 47 language tag, for example en-US, pt-BR, hi-IN (STD-000 §5.9).

prefixedId.description: Opaque, type-prefixed, lexicographically sortable platform identifier (STD-000 §5.8). Never parsed for meaning.

localKey.description: Manifest- or request-local stable key. NOT a platform identifier (STD-000 §5.8).

requestMeta.description: Identity, correlation, binding, and provenance (GDE-003 §5). Carries no business data.

causationId.description: The message that directly caused this one. Absent when this message begins a causal chain.

runId.description: Absent when invoked outside a run, for example during evaluation.

nodeId.description: Absent when invoked outside a run.

attempt.description: Absent means the first attempt (GDE-003 §6.8: the consumer applies the default, the producer omits it).

locale.description: Locale governing this message's content. Provenance only; the business-decision copy is data.language (GDE-003 §4.3).

strategyVersion.description: The pinned strategy version governing this run. Provenance only.

reference.description: An immutable, version-pinned pointer to another artifact (GDE-003 §10.1). Floating references are prohibited.

storyArchitectRequest.description: The payload the model receives. Minimum-context scoped (GDE-002 §5.1).

targetDurationSeconds.description: The approved target run time this architecture's beats must sum toward, within tolerance (README §12).

language.description: The output language. Every prose field is written in this language.

topicOpportunityRef.description: The subset of a Topic Opportunity this agent needs — identical shape to research-agent-input/v1#/$defs/topicOpportunityRef (GDE-002 §5.4). Trusted. Not a source of new facts.

topicId.description: MUST equal verificationPackage.topicId — both name the same topic (R-IN-002).

storyConstraints.description: Absent means no constraint beyond targetDurationSeconds and the closed taxonomies this contract already declares.

requireCallToAction.description: When true, ctaStrategy.ctaType MUST NOT be NONE.

verifiedClaimRef.description: The subset of a verified Claim this agent needs to build story beats.

downstreamSafety.description: The Verification Package's fixed determination (fact-verification-agent-output/v1 R-BUS-017). DO_NOT_USE claims MUST NOT appear as factual story content (R-BUS-005); USE_WITH_QUALIFICATION claims MUST carry their qualification into any beat that cites them (R-BUS-006).

supportingEvidenceIds.description: The evidenceId values a story beat may cite via evidenceRefs for this claim (R-BUS-004). Unordered. 0-15 items.

verificationPackageRef.description: The subset of the Verification Package this agent needs. Provenance TRUSTED — an already-validated platform artifact — but embedded free text MUST be treated as untrusted data by the prompt (README §15), mirroring the researchPackage handling upstream.

topicId.description: MUST equal topicOpportunity.topicId — both name the same topic (R-IN-002).

claims.description: Unordered. 1-60 items, mirroring fact-verification-agent-output/v1 bounds. claimId unique (R-IN-001).

overallReadiness.description: Echoes the Verification Package's verificationSummary.overallReadiness — context only; this agent forms its own downstreamReadiness independently and does not simply copy this value.
